name: Those Who Dont Believe
overview: Scripture reveals that belief in Jesus Christ is the decisive factor between condemnation and eternal life, as God gave His only Son so that whoever believes in Him will not perish but have everlasting life (John 3:16, 18). Those who do not believe are already condemned because they reject the name of the Son of God. Furthermore, coming to Christ is only possible through the drawing of the Father (John 6:44), emphasizing God's sovereign role in salvation. Belief is not merely intellectual assent but involves embracing the difficult truths of Christ's sacrifice, which many find challenging to accept (John 6:55-60). Meanwhile, believers are warned to be vigilant against false teachers who appear harmless but are spiritually dangerous (Matthew 7:15).
